name: error-modal
opens_with: (a scripted agent error — no keystroke opens it)
notes: The highest-priority surface in the ladder: it renders and then RETURNS, so every other overlay and notification is suppressed while it is up. Three regressions it uniquely protects: the early return being lost, the scroll-offset / footer-anchored layout, and the '⚠ Error' header. not-contains:Response complete is the early-return discriminator — that toast is drawn by the code path the return skips, so losing the return makes the needle fail. any_modal_open is deliberately NOT asserted: the error modal is a Notification and not an overlay_flags entry, so it never sets that flag, and the boot-time voice_mode_notice that does set it cannot be dismissed here without also dismissing the modal (Esc and prompt-submit both call dismiss_error_notifications). The script ends at `error` with no trailing `done` because that is the real agent's shape: both AgentEvent::Error sites in operant-core/src/agent/run.rs (445, 1652) return Err immediately, and handle_agent_event auto-dismisses error notifications on the next Content/Thinking/Reasoning/Done — so an error-then-done script dismisses the modal before it is ever painted.
